body:
Independent M2 Code Review covers 8d052069..646301e8 against the unchanged approved primary plan and RF/CLI Design, current upstream assessments and m2-implementation evidence. The parent authored implementation and tests; this reviewer authored neither. The inspected slice adds complete/narrow writes, current v3 Finding operations, optional Verify basis edits and response dispatch. M3 reads and M4 public creation remain excluded from this milestone.

The core mutation path correctly selects contract-specific operation schemas, preserves the v2 vocabulary, rejects unsupported new operations on v2, and uses the shared candidate/preservation engine. Whole-field edits preserve neighboring bytes and semantic no-ops; assessment replacement remains separate from explicit findings and applicability. Verify full replacement inserts or removes its optional basis while narrow updates cannot retarget it. Distinct explanation fields compose and overlapping full/set fields reject. Optional-member token construction avoids rewriting the whole stored document.

Response inspection shows recognized new commands choose schema 3 even before request/store access, while retained commands attach v3 after validated stored selection. Duplicate change selectors are omitted from failure identity; invalid inputs and unknown operation tags retain closed failures. Structural comparison confirms existing schema definitions remain unchanged except mutation/result union extensions. The top-level binary and recording-family dispatcher retain their routing, and independent real-bin executions directly exercised both new commands rather than treating exported-adapter tests alone as public proof.

One material correction remains in the optional effect receipt. Complete Verify removal expands verification_basis for overlap and candidate deletion but the emitted effects.changed_fields still uses only submitted values keys. Therefore a requested detailed receipt omits the actual basis removal, although the file and ordinary changed target are correct. This is an actionable M2 constructor/receipt defect under the retained effect contract, not a missing Design decision. A focused regression should observe the detailed public result for that complete reassessment.

Independent execution: node --test packages/rigorloop/test/record-store-v3-mutations.test.js passed all 12 cases. A Node stdin harness spawned the actual packages/rigorloop/dist/bin/rigorloop.js and checked eight outcomes: Review/Verify successful summary writes plus malformed-input, duplicate-change and unknown-selector failures for each, including schema version, tags, exit codes and stored values. These passed. A separate Node stdin reproduction validated a complete Verify request omitting an existing verification_basis, called constructMutation, and observed the basis absent from candidate bytes but missing from effects.changed_fields. The author evidence separately records 235 broad regressions and parity/metadata/whitespace checks; those passes do not disprove this unasserted receipt omission.

Test quality and maintenance otherwise cover explicit expected values, field closure, no-op bytes, stale revisions and read basis, finding versus assessment separation, applicability batching, preview and schema-2 controls. Existing v2 definitions are retained rather than widened to accept new operation tags. The remaining correction requires independent reassessment before route closes M2. M3/M4 and distinct final whole-change review/Verify are still required. No work state, implementation, route, final readiness or adoption claim is made by this review.

findings.evidence:
Finding ID: code-review-m2-f1
Severity: minor
Location: packages/rigorloop/dist/lib/recording-construction.js:87-92, optional Verify removal and effect emission. CLI receipt contract at docs/design/cli/cli.md:276.
A complete verify.record against a record containing verification_basis omits that optional field to remove it. The constructor expands keys and deletes the member, but the final effect uses Object.keys(values). Independently reproduced: candidate has no verification_basis while effects.changed_fields lists only verifier, subjects, evidence_refs, review_refs, outcome, summary, assessment_scope, rationale, limitations and changes. The detailed mutation receipt therefore fails to report the actual basis removal. Ordinary changed target and stored values remain correct.

origin.rationale: Detailed effects must describe the actual explicit reassessment changes, including the contract-defined optional basis removal; submitted member names alone are insufficient.
origin.required_outcome: Include the optional verification_basis removal in the emitted explicit field effects for complete Verify reassessment. Add a regression observing --details on the public mutation boundary, asserting candidate/stored absence and that changed_fields contains verification_basis; retain no-op, byte-preservation and narrow-update restrictions. Safe resolution path: bounded M2 implementation correction and independent rereview; no owner decision is needed.
